body:
Describe the bug
AttributeError: 'RenderableTrajectory' object has no attribute 'poses' when rendering REASONING_OVERLAY video with the alpamayo1_5 driver. The simulation completes successfully and the ASL file is written, but video rendering fails after processing ~15 frames.
To Reproduce

Clone NVlabs/alpasim and run source setup_local_env.sh
Download nvidia/Alpamayo-1.5-10B and nvidia/Cosmos-Reason2-8B via huggingface-cli
Run:

uv run alpasim_wizard deploy=local topology=1gpu driver=alpamayo1_5 \
  wizard.log_dir=$PWD/test_ar15 \
  eval.video.video_layouts=[REASONING_OVERLAY]

Simulation completes successfully but no mp4 is written

Expected behavior
A REASONING_OVERLAY mp4 should be generated in rollouts/{scene_id}/{uuid}/ as it is with driver=alpamayo1.
Screenshots
N/A
Desktop (please complete the following information):

OS: Ubuntu 22.04
Nvidia driver/CUDA version: Driver 580.105.08, CUDA 13.0
GPU: NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3 (Lambda Labs cloud instance)
AlpaSim version: 0.66.0

Additional context
Full traceback from stdout log:
runtime-0-1 | Error rendering video: 'RenderableTrajectory' object has no attribute 'poses'
  File "/repo/src/eval/src/eval/video.py", line 146, in render_video_from_eval_result
  File "/repo/src/eval/src/eval/video.py", line 83, in render_and_save_video
  File "/repo/src/eval/src/eval/video_reasoning_overlay_utils.py", line 545, in render_reasoning_overlay_style_video
  File "/repo/src/eval/src/eval/video_reasoning_overlay_utils.py", line 448, in _render_single_reasoning_overlay_frame
AttributeError: 'RenderableTrajectory' object has no attribute 'poses'
Rendering starts (15/198 frames) then crashes. The bug does not occur with driver=alpamayo1. Likely a data structure change introduced with the 1.5 integration.

comments.body: I think maybe you got unlucky in that you tried it just before the most recent sync. I think this issue is solved on TOT. If you disagree, please, reopen.

title: [Bug] REASONING_OVERLAY video rendering fails with AttributeError when using alpamayo1_5 driver
